cases.disposition_reason: Holla activities-multi at 120×40 in truecolor with paused motion and HOLLA_NO_HISTORY=1 opens the finder. Ctrl+G opens Activities with frontend dev highlighted. Esc returns to the finder. Live activities make Ctrl+Q a destructive dialog: Dialog::destructive focuses Stay, and Stop and quit is drawn beside it. Right then Enter confirms stop. The activities stay cancelling. World::tick in src/bin/holla/sim/world.rs returns before self.tick increments when !clock.running, and clock.running is false for paused motion in src/bin/holla/domain/fixtures.rs, so TERM_EXIT_TICKS never elapse and the process does not exit. Duration follows world.tick in src/bin/holla/domain/activity.rs duration_ticks and stays 0 s. The test does not call finish while the dialog is open.
cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario activities-multi --color truecolor --motion paused at 120x40; Ctrl+G
cases.return_path: Esc returns to the finder. Confirming Stop and quit leaves the process running because the paused clock never reaps the activities.

cases.disposition_reason: Ctrl+G opens Activities. The first row is frontend dev. Down highlights api dev and leaves frontend dev unhighlighted. The open picker is captured at 120×40, then at 80×24, and the narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Enter opens api dev. The body is $ mise run dev  (services/api) and the insight names port 8080. It does not contain VITE v6.3.1, http://localhost:5173/, or the tick-41 listening line. activities_multi calls World::tick 48 times, but World::tick in src/bin/holla/sim/world.rs returns before self.tick increments when !clock.running, and clock.running is false for paused motion in src/bin/holla/domain/fixtures.rs. Duration follows world.tick in src/bin/holla/domain/activity.rs duration_ticks and stays 0 s. Reduced motion would keep changing that text. Confirming Stop and quit marks the activities cancelling and does not exit, because a paused clock never delivers TERM_EXIT_TICKS.
cases.action_sequence: Open the picker and choose one activity.
cases.expected_results: The opened output is that activity's output.
cases.forbidden_effects: The picker opens the first activity regardless of the highlight.
